The files `did_syntax_valid.txt` and `did_syntax_invalid.txt` are copied, unchanged, from the ATProto interop tests:

https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto-interop-tests/tree/main/syntax (commit 056e574)

(They test DID syntax in general — any DID method — not just the DID methods ATProto allows.)

The file `did_plc_ewvi7nxzyoun6zhxrhs64oiz.json` is the DID document that https://plc.directory/did:plc:ewvi7nxzyoun6zhxrhs64oiz returned on 2026-11-24.
